name: Cape Verde (1975–1992)
description: A red vertical stripe at the hoist bearing a black five-pointed star within a wreath of maize ears above a clam shell, and a fly of two horizontal stripes of yellow over green.
history: Flag adopted at independence from Portugal on 5 July 1975, based on the flag of the PAIGC, the party that had fought for the independence of both Guinea-Bissau and Cape Verde, and differing from Guinea-Bissau's flag by the wreath of maize and the shell. After the end of one-party rule the present blue flag became official on 25 September 1992.
